security_implications: The chunk monitors a bug injection facility (TLUL_BUG001) that can corrupt transaction data (a_data) and its integrity tag (data_intg). If this mechanism is not strictly limited to simulation or protected by lifecycle state (e.g., lc_dft_en, debug unlock), an attacker able to assert tlul_bug_001_fire could silently modify bus data and bypass integrity checks, leading to data integrity failures, privilege escalation, or secret leakage. The combination of data+integrity tampering represents a high-severity risk.
